approximate_exp: approximate the exponential function on an MPCTensor using a limit approximation with configurable iterations
approximate_log: approximate the natural logarithm of an MPCTensor using modified Householder iterations
compute_reciprocal: compute the reciprocal of an MPCTensor using Newton-Raphson or log-based methods
compute_softmax: compute the softmax of an MPCTensor along a given dimension using exp and reciprocal
compute_trig_functions: compute cosine and sine of an MPCTensor via the complex exponential e^(ix) approximation
